[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:384YE Autumn]]
__NOTOC__
<quote by="Proposed: Mournwold, Seconded: Ossium">To build a mana sinecure in Happiston in the Chalkdowns in the Mournwold. Creating the title Keeper of the Prosperous Potato Fields of Happiston. To be appointed with tenure by the unanimous decisions of the Marcher senators. Fully funded by the Happiston Volunteers.</quote>
==Overview==
* Commissions a mana crystal [[sinecure]] in [[Mournwold]]
* Passed
==Date==
* Autumn 384YE
==Cost==
* [[Sinecure#Costs|Standard costs]] apply
* The costs for the sinecure have not been defined in the motion so the civil service assumes minimum size (10 wains)

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Fields_of_Happiston}}
==Outcome==
* Once complete, the sinecure is intended to provide mana to the Imperial title appointed to oversee it, although the mechanism whereby it will do so is not clear.
* This motion was missing [[Commission#Necessary_Details|necessary details]] regarding the nature of the sinecure, and the cost to create it. These were provided after the Winter Solstice 384YE, and the commission is now complete, with the [[Keeper of the Happiston Fields]] ready to be appointed at the Spring Equinox 385YE

<!--
The prosperous potato fields of Happiston (pronounced Haze-tun, spelt with 2 ps like it sounds) produce mana through the mithril inlaid scarecrows scattered throughout the farmland on the chalk downs near the recently refurbished Marcher town of Happiston. Each scarecrow has mithril rods which harness the ambient magic across the Mournwold and as the wind blows they condense the mana around the base of the scarecrows giving the appearance that they are growing from the soil and are harvested by the Guardian as if they were crops.
-->
